Aery: Sky Castle is a very unique flight game featuring a little bird that discovers an unknown world full of beauty and dreamy landscapes, little environmental riddles, and other surprises. It's a story-driven adventure to discover and rescue a broken world.

The game has relatively slow pacing as it is meant to help people to enjoy and relax after a day full of hassle.

In Aery – A Journey Beyond Time you are in the role of a flying god-like creature which observes the world and their inhabitants while they grow and evolve.

You can quite literally fly through history and the different stages of human development, follow an interesting story through time, and enjoy the speed of flying at the same time.

This story-driven game is non-violent so that you can enjoy the intuitive and relaxing gameplay in 12 different stages of the development of our earth.

fields.value: Aery: Calm Mind is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect the missing feathers of your little bird friend. Because there are no enemies or any danger of any kind you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle. Every level has two parts. A first introduction into the overall theme and a second one that gives a little more time to play around and to enjoy the beauty of the area. Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment.

Aery – Four Seasons is a relaxing, story-driven flight exploration game that carries you through a living world as it turns slowly from one season into the next. You play as a tiny bird-shaped spirit, drifting endlessly forward as the land beneath you blossoms, ripens, fades, and freezes — a full year unfolding one wingbeat at a time.

Begin in the first breath of spring, gliding over orchards heavy with pink and white blossom as meltwater trickles down from the last patches of snow and everything reaches greedily for the light. Drift into the long golden afternoons of summer, where wildflower meadows ripple in the warm air, still lakes mirror the sky, and fireflies begin to glow as the day softens toward dusk. Soar through the amber and crimson forests of autumn, leaves spiraling loose around you and mist gathering in the valleys as great flocks gather to move on. And finally, settle into the deep hush of winter — frozen lakes, bare silver trees, and a night sky rippling with quiet color over the snow.

Each season is its own self-contained world: a unique color palette, atmosphere, and mood that tells a different piece of a larger, quietly unfolding story. Hidden across every landscape are glowing memory fragments — scattered clues to the life this world holds through its endless turning. Collect enough of them and the season shifts, carrying you gently into the next.

Aery – Four Seasons is designed above all else to feel good. The flying is smooth and freeing, the world is warm and beautiful, and the story unfolds gently without ever demanding anything of you. Whether you play to explore, to collect, or simply to get lost somewhere peaceful, there is always something new waiting just beyond the changing horizon
